title: Rider Terms: Disputes of Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
Disputing a fee is the rider's own claim and is made by the rider, at most once per assessment. These terms apply to a Cleaning and Damage Fees charge at every fee level.

## The dispute window

A dispute is accepted only within the dispute window: The dispute window is counted in calendar days from the charge date: day 1 is the calendar day after the charge, and the dispute must be filed no later than the last day of the window. The window is 30 calendar days at every level, and the charge date is the one on the assessment record.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | the charge date on the assessment |
| Day 1 | the calendar day after the charge |
| Unit | calendar days |
| Last day | day 30 |
| A dispute filed on the last day | accepted |

Boundary pair (hypothetical dates): a fee charged on 10 March has day 1 on 11 March and day 30 on 9 April. A dispute filed on 9 April is accepted; one filed on 10 April is outside the window.

## How a dispute is decided

1. A disputed fee is upheld when the evidence on file met the level's photo and receipt requirements at approval, and reversed in full otherwise (insufficient evidence).
2. The rider's account alone never reverses a fee backed by evidence that meets the standard.
3. When the evidence supports only a lower level, the assessment is moved down, the difference is refunded, and the fee is upheld at the lower level.

## Full reversal on the record

A fee is also reversed in full, with or without a dispute, when the records show the charge was against the wrong rider (wrong rider), duplicated another assessment (duplicate report) or was reported outside the filing window (filed outside window).

## Outcomes at a glance

| What the records show | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Evidence met the level's photo and receipt requirements at approval | Fee upheld; the rider's account alone does not change this |
| Evidence did not meet those requirements at approval | Fee reversed in full (insufficient evidence) |
| Evidence supports only a lower level | Assessment moved down, difference refunded, fee upheld at the lower level |
| Charge against the wrong rider, a duplicate of another assessment, or a report outside the filing window | Fee reversed in full, whether or not disputed |
